t: FTB Filter System is a powerful mod which allows many types of filter condition to be combined in interesting ways with an intuitive GUI. If FFS is installed (if you're reading this, it is!), $(item)Smart Filter/$ items from the mod can be placed in a module's filter slots, and will filter items appropriately.
FTB过滤系统是一个功能强大的模组，它允许你以有趣的方式组合多种过滤条件，并配有直观易用的图形用户界面。如果已安装FTB过滤系统（既然你正在阅读本说明，那它肯定已安装！），该模组提供的$(item)智能过滤器/$物品可放置于模块的过滤槽中，并能正确地对物品进行过滤。
Limitation: FFS Smart Filters can't be configured while installed as Modular Routers filters can be; you will need to have the filter item in your inventory to reconfigure it.
限制：FFS 智能过滤器不像物品路由器的过滤器那样能在安装状态下直接配置；你必须先把过滤器物品拿到自己的物品栏中，才能重新配置。
